one_factor.known_request_difference: On all 1,080 rows the rendered Perception, Reviewer and Planner requests are byte-identical to the sealed anchor's, and the Solver request differs only by the twenty traced train-exemplars content blocks: removing exactly those blocks reproduces the anchor's Solver envelope on 1,080 of 1,080 rows (4 of 4 on the smoke roster). render_phase_prompt_envelopes accumulates supply in DECLARATION order (perception, reviewer, planner, solver), so the static render shows the blocks only at the Solver; at dispatch the native episode runs perception -> solver -> reviewer -> planner and the supplied values stay visible in the accumulated QueryState, so the Reviewer and Planner requests that follow a Solver contact carry the same blocks. That runtime propagation is stated, not measured here; the native contact fit gate fits every realized request immediately before dispatch.
